ShortDescription.Value: Apply custom surfaces to road pavement, sidewalks, bike lanes and bus lanes, with reusable presets and junction controls.

## AI development and maintenance disclaimer
This mod was made using AI. I am not a developer and have zero programming knowledge, so I may struggle to fix bugs, keep the mod working after game updates, or maintain it over time.
Source code, bug reports and maintenance enquiries can be found on the project's [GitHub](https://github.com/Andy123k1/RoadSurfaceFiller) page, which you can find through the [official Cities: Skylines Modding Discord](https://discord.gg/HTav7ARPs2).
If you are a developer willing to help maintain the mod or take over the project, please contact me through that Discord. I am happy to discuss handing over the GitHub repository so the project can continue to be supported.
# Road Surface Filler
Give your roads custom pavement, sidewalk, bike-lane and bus-lane finishes using the surfaces installed in your game.
## Features - Create reusable surface presets for different roads and lanes. - Choose whether editing a preset updates roads already using it or keeps their existing finishes. - Choose a preset while drawing roads, or use the road tool's Replace mode to restyle existing segments. - Apply general rules to existing roads with Apply city rules. - Cycle the junction finish between connected road and bus-lane surfaces while keeping bike-lane surfaces visible. - Fill adjacent paved bus-lane shoulders, or remove that shoulder fill from selected roads. - Convert generated surfaces into independent editable areas, with a tool to resume automatic updates later. - Restore selected roads or all roads to vanilla surfaces. - Manage rules in a movable, resizable panel with collapsible rule cards.
## Getting started Open the RSF button beside the Info button. Create a preset under Segment rules, then select it in the road tool's Surface rule picker. To apply general rules across existing roads, create them under General rules and choose Apply city rules.
## Manual surface editing Under Tools, choose Make generated surfaces editable, select roads and press Apply changes once generation has finished. Their areas become independent and automatic updates stop on those roads. Select all approaches to edit a whole junction or roundabout. Choose an Editor surface and Open surface editor to reshape areas with the game's area tool; editing applies the chosen finish. Manual areas survive rebuilds and road changes, including road removal, and are kept by Restore all roads. Resume automatic surfaces reactivates saved rules while keeping manual areas, so remove unwanted overlaps yourself. Keep this mod and the relevant surface assets enabled for these areas to render.
## Surface packs This mod uses available surface assets; it does not include the custom surface packs shown in screenshots. Install the packs containing the finishes you want to use. Those packs may have their own dependencies.
## Saved cities Segment finishes and junction choices are saved with the city. Rule and preset libraries remain in the mod's settings.
Surface appearance depends on the road geometry and the selected surface assets. When reporting a problem, include a screenshot, the road type and the surface pack used.

# Version 0.5.28
Includes all updates from versions 0.5.25 through 0.5.28.
## Junction and roundabout improvements
- Combines compatible surface pieces into larger areas, reducing unnecessary fragmentation at junctions and roundabouts. - Reduces repeated clipping and geometry processing when generating and rebuilding road surfaces. - Improves the joining of curved junction pieces and the handling of small precision gaps and complex outlines, reducing cases that produce large numbers of tiny surfaces. - Preserves roundabout islands, protected bike and bus lanes, sidewalks and planted areas when combining surfaces. Different finishes and road levels remain separate. - Fixes highway-only roundabouts using street rules, which could leave them without the intended surfaces. Roundabouts with street approaches retain their street-rule selection.
## Manual surface editing
- Adds **Make generated surfaces editable** under Tools. Select roads and press **Apply changes** to convert their generated surfaces into independent areas. - Adds **Open surface editor** to reshape areas using the game's surface tool. Choose an **Editor surface** first; editing applies that finish. - Converted areas keep manual edits through rebuilds, rule changes and road changes. They remain after road removal and are kept by the vanilla restoration tools. - Saves the road's manual setting with the city and carries it through road splits and replacements. - Adds **Resume automatic surfaces** to reactivate the selected roads' saved rules. Independent areas are kept, so remove unwanted overlaps manually.
## After updating
- Use **Rebuild applied surfaces** to replace older fragmented overlays while keeping saved road finishes. **Refresh surfaces** only refreshes the surface list. - If a roundabout has no surface after rebuilding, select a road near it and use **Cycle junction surface** under Tools to apply a junction finish. - To manually edit an entire junction or roundabout, convert all its approaches because its surfaces can belong to several roads. - Keep Road Surface Filler and the relevant surface assets enabled for converted areas to render.
